## durin --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
durin — Onboard and connect your organization to your preferred agent

Usage:
  durin                         Choose login or signup, onboard, and set up an agent
  durin login | signup          Start or resume interactive onboarding
  durin install                 Resume interactive agent onboarding
  durin verify                  Verify authenticated MCP access
  durin profiles list           Show saved organization profiles
  durin profiles use <id>       Change the terminal profile
  durin logout [--force]        Revoke and clear this profile’s MCP grant
  durin tools list              List authorized tools as JSON
  durin tools inspect <name>    Print a tool's native schema
  durin tools call <name> --input <file|-> --idempotency-key <key>
                                Invoke a tool; retain the key when retrying
  durin mcp serve               Serve the selected profile over stdio
  durin mcp endpoint            Print the personal URL for a direct MCP client
  durin hooks status            Show local checker and hook configuration status
  durin hooks run --harness <id> Run a configured local pre-tool checker (JSON stdin)
  durin hooks run --harness <id> --event <name>
                                Handle one harness hook event (JSON stdin)
  durin observer status         Show the local observer service and capture status
  durin observer install | remove
                                Install or remove the observer service
  durin observer purge          Delete everything the observer captured
  durin observer export         Print the decrypted capture as JSON lines
  durin observe                 Run the observer (the service runs this)

Options:
  --profile <id>                Select an explicit organization profile
  --config-dir <path>           Profile directory (default: ~/.config/durin)
  --approval-id <id>            Resume a tool call after approval
  --force                       logout: clear the local grant even if revocation fails
  --app-url <origin>            Durin app origin (default: https://app.getdurin.com)
  --dev                        Allow loopback hosts and HTTP for local development
  --harness <id>                hooks run: selected built-in or custom harness
  --event <name>                hooks run: the harness hook event being handled
  -h, --help                   Show this help

Agent selection happens during onboarding. Direct MCP clients authorize separately.
--- stderr

## durin --app-url http://example.com --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Use an HTTPS app origin, or --dev with loopback HTTP.
## durin --app-url https://example.com/path --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
--app-url must be an origin without a path.
## durin --app-url https://user@example.com --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Use an HTTPS app origin, or --dev with loopback HTTP.
## durin --app-url https://example.com?x=1 --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Use an HTTPS app origin, or --dev with loopback HTTP.
## durin --app-url https://example.com.. --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
--app-url example.com.. ends in more than one dot, so it names no durin app.
## durin --app-url http://127.0.0.1:9 --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Use an HTTPS app origin, or --dev with loopback HTTP.
## durin --app-url not a url --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Use an HTTPS app origin, or --dev with loopback HTTP.
## durin --app-url https://EXAMPLE.com --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
--app-url must be an origin without a path.
## durin --app-url https://example.com. --config-dir <TMP>/config
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Run durin in an interactive terminal to complete onboarding.

exit: 1
